stories.title: Judicial Check or Judicial Activism? Supreme Court Blocks Trump's Transgender Inmate Policy
stories.conservative_headline: Unelected Judges Force Taxpayers to Fund Prison Sex Changes as Thomas and Alito Dissent
stories.liberal_headline: Supreme Court Hands Trump a Stinging Defeat, Protecting Transgender Inmates' Basic Health Care
stories.poll_question: Should federal prisons be required to provide gender-affirming care to inmates?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Bureau of Prisons should set policy without judges overriding its judgment.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Denying medically necessary treatment to inmates violates constitutional rights.

stories.title: Election Integrity or Federal Power Grab? Democrats Sue Over Trump's Move on State Election Rules
stories.conservative_headline: Democrats Rush to Court to Block Common-Sense Safeguards Against Noncitizen Voting
stories.liberal_headline: Democrats Sue to Stop Trump From Seizing States' Constitutional Power Over Elections
stories.poll_question: Who should control how elections are administered?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Washington must enforce uniform rules to stop fraud and noncitizen voting.
stories.poll_option2_desc: The Constitution gives states authority; federal meddling threatens free elections.

stories.title: Affordability Crisis or Media Doom Loop? 3.7% Inflation Collides With the Midterms
stories.conservative_headline: Wages, Energy Boom and Social Security Raise: Media Ignores Trump's Economic Wins
stories.liberal_headline: Prices Up 3.7% as Paychecks Shrink: Americans Are Falling Behind Under Trump
stories.poll_question: Is the Trump economy working for ordinary Americans?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Tariffs and energy policy are rebuilding American industry; adjustment takes time.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Inflation is wiping out wage gains and crushing household budgets.

stories.title: Record Deficit or Growth Investment? Federal Shortfall Nears $2 Trillion
stories.conservative_headline: Washington's Spending Addiction, Not Tax Cuts, Drove the Deficit — Cut the Bureaucracy
stories.liberal_headline: Deficit Explodes 12% in a Year as Trump Tax Cuts Blow a Hole in the Budget
stories.poll_question: What's driving the nearly $2 trillion deficit?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Entitlements and bloated agencies, not tax relief, are the real problem.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Giveaways to the wealthy gutted revenue while working families pay more.

stories.title: Border Wall Blocked or Nature Protected? Judge Halts Construction in Big Bend
stories.conservative_headline: Activist Judge Stops the Wall That Delivered Record-Low Border Crossings
stories.liberal_headline: Court Halts Trump's Bulldozers in Big Bend as Wall Tears Through Protected Land
stories.poll_question: Should border wall construction proceed through protected lands?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Sovereignty and security come first; courts shouldn't block border enforcement.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Bulldozing public lands for a wall causes irreversible environmental damage.

stories.title: Peace Through Strength or Appeasement? Trump Floats Putin and Xi Summits as Zelenskyy Scrambles

stories.poll_question: Is Trump's Russia diplomacy the right approach?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Only direct talks with Putin can stop the killing and free Americans.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Sidelining Ukraine hands Putin a victory and emboldens future invasions.

stories.title: Merit or Discrimination? Supreme Court Takes Up Race and School Admissions Again

stories.poll_option1_desc: Admissions should be based on test scores and achievement alone.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Schools need tools to ensure opportunity for underrepresented students.

stories.title: Fake News Accountability or Press Intimidation? Trump Weighs Evicting the White House Press Corps

stories.poll_option1_desc: No outlet is entitled to permanent space inside the president's house.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Removing reporters is retaliation designed to shield the president from scrutiny.

stories.title: Deportation Reprieve or Amnesty by Another Name? 100,000 Ukrainians and Sudanese Get Protection

stories.poll_option2_desc: Sending people back to active war zones is cruel and dangerous.
